en.headline: Police seize drugs worth 1.42 million dollars in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: West Kowloon detectives searched a subdivided flat after stopping a woman outside and found suspected cocaine, methamphetamine and packaging tools.
body: The West Kowloon Regional Crime Unit said officers carried out an anti-drug operation on Monday evening after intelligence analysis and further inquiries.

Police said officers stopped a woman outside a subdivided flat in Cheung Sha Wan and found about 60 grams of suspected cocaine and about 267 grams of suspected methamphetamine in her handbag. A search of the flat she rented turned up about 1.17 kilograms of suspected methamphetamine, about 746 grams of suspected cocaine, about 179 grams of suspected crack cocaine, and packaging tools including an electronic scale and resealable bags. Police put the street value of the drugs at about 1.42 million dollars.

A 38-year-old woman was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in a dangerous drug. Police said she was being detained and would later be charged with one count of trafficking. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking can bring a fine of up to 5 million dollars and life imprisonment on conviction, police said.

zh.headline: 警方在長沙灣劏房檢獲市值約142萬元毒品
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組周一晚在長沙灣截查一名女子後搜查其租住劏房，檢獲懷疑可卡因、冰毒及包裝工具。
body: 西九龍總區重案組表示，人員經情報分析及深入調查後，周一晚上展開反毒品行動。
警方稱，人員在長沙灣一個劏房單位外截查一名女子，在其手袋檢獲約60克懷疑可卡因及約267克懷疑冰毒。其後搜查該名女子租住的劏房，再搜出約1.17公斤懷疑冰毒、約746克懷疑可卡因、約179克懷疑霹靂可卡因，以及電子磅和大量可再封膠袋等包裝工具。警方估計檢獲毒品總市值約142萬元。
警方以涉嫌販運危險藥物拘捕一名38歲女子。她正被扣留調查，稍後將被暫控一項販運危險藥物罪。警方重申，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物一經定罪，最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
